༄༅/ /o rgyan rin po che bde gshegs spyi dril du bsgrubs pa'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis nor bu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// o rgyan rin po che bde gshegs spyi dril du bsgrubs pa'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis nor bu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo pad+mā kā ra ya/ gang la bsten na las nyon gyi// bag chags mun pa drungs phyung ba'i// thugs rje'i nyin byed lham me ba// rtsa gsum rgyal la gus pas btud// de la 'dir lha gcig bsgrubs pas lha kun 'grub pa'i nye lam zab mo/ de yang deng dus sangs rgyas gzhan las byin rlabs myur ba lhag pa'i o rgyan chen po'i byin rlabs mngon du 'bebs ba'i bskyed rdzogs tho tsam bkod pa ste/ gang de'i sku rten gyi mdun du phyi nang gi mchod rdzas gang 'dzoms dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs rgyas par bshams la/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba gnas bdag dang bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin chen snod yangs par// kham yig 'od zhu gtor ma 'dod dgu yi// longs spyod rgya chen zad med nam mkha' mdzod// so so'i yid mthun du mas gang bar gyur// a kā ro sa byin brlabs/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// rin chen gser g.yu'i skyems sogs yid 'ong ldan// gang 'dod blo yis dngos sprul 'di dag ni// phyogs skyong sde brgyad la sogs yul gnas bdag /kun la 'bul gyi rnal 'byor bsam pa'i don// thogs med 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol// sarba bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta khā hi/ zhes dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul/ hūm̐/ nga ni ye nas chos dbyings ngang*// rang byung pad+ma he ru ka /'jigs pa'i khro rgyal rdo rje'i sku// ye shes rol pa'i me dpung 'bar// hūm̐ hūm̐/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis glud gtor byin gyis brlabs nas/ snang srid log 'dren gdon bgegs dang*// lan chags 'byung po gnod byed tshogs// kun kyang 'dir 'dus glud gtor longs// tshims par spyod la mtha' med pa// gnas med yul du 'gro bar gyis// gal te bsgo ba las 'das na// dbang chen khros pa'i rngams zer gyis// 'chol ba'i khro bo khro chung dang*// lcags sdigs me char drag po spros// rdul dmyal tshal bar 'thor bar 'gyur// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ zhes bgegs bskrad la/ rang gi thugs las 'od zer dang*// rdo rje me ri phyogs bcur spros// bar mtshams med par gang bar gyur// sra brtan srung 'khor gzhom du med// badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gis bsrung 'khor bsgom la/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ na mo/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde bar gshegs// mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum rab 'byams// kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng la// bdag sogs sems can skyabs su gsol// 'khor ba duḥkha'i rgya mtsho las// bsgral nas myang 'das mchog gi lam// bkod phyir tshad med gzhan phan blos// byang chub chen pos sems bskyed do// de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las khams gsum phyi snod gtor gzhong du// nang bcud gnas yul bkod pa rdzas su bshams// kun kyang rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// zag med nam mkha' mdzod bzhin sprin spro gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ba liṃ ta ga ṇa gu h+ye sa ma ye swā hā/ ces byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bdag mdun gcig char bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa dngos snang gnyis 'dzin sbyangs nas/ stong ba'i ngang las dri med dwangs gsal g.yo ba med// rin chen 'byung gnas rgya che gting zab mtha' mi mngon// de dbus pad+ma dkar po 'dab stong ge sar rgyas// nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor thabs shes gzi 'od 'bar ba'i steng*// hrīḥdamar 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i don byas nas// rgyal ba'i rnam rol ma hā gu ru pad+mā kā ra ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog gangs la nyi shar bzhin// dkar dmar mdangs mdzes zhi 'dzum gzhon nu lo brgyad tshul// spyan gsum lta stangs chos nyid skye med dbyings su gzigs// dzam+bu'i gser gyi snyan cha mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdub// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin// g.yon pas thod pa tshe bum nor bus bkang ba bsnams// shes rab mtshon byed gru mor kha ṭām̐ dku la brten// pad zhwa sgro dar rat+nas brgyan pa dbu la gsol// za 'og mthing ka'i phod ka chos gos rnam gsum dang*// thun mtshams 'char ka'i mdangs ldan ber chen lhubs par gsol// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gsal// mtshan dang dpe byad nyi ma stong gi gzi 'od 'bar// bde chen ye shes chos sku'i zhing khams yongs la khyab// rab 'byams zhing kun ma lus sku yi bkod par rdzogs// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon gsal bar gyur// steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar snang 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor klong*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa nyan rang byang sems dang*// rig 'dzin grub thob gsar rnying bka' brgyud bla ma sogs// rgyud sde bzhi yi yi dam zhi khro ḍā ki ma// dpa' bo dam can chos srung nor lha gter bdag po// thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs bkra lam me// skyabs yul zhing du mngon par nyid du snang ba yi// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso mchog gnas gsum nas// lnga ldan 'od zer zer thag dbang po'i gzhu lta bu// 'og min nges pa lnga ldan rang snang sprul pa'i zhing*// phyogs bcu'i mtha' klas rang bzhin rnam par dag zhing nas// bder gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// mkha' dbyings gang bar spyan drangs bdag mdun lha tshogs dang*// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med chu la chu bzhag ltar// mnyam nyid bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du bzhugs// oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+mā kā ra sarba ta thā ga ta de wa ḍāk+ki ni ma hā kā la kā li sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ

zhes spyan drangs la/ bdag mdun thugs las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha// spyan drangs dri med sim byed rgyun 'bab kyi// khrus gsol gsang gsum bde chen dgyes pa bskyed// rigs bdag mtha' yas sprul skus dbu brgyan gyur// de nas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ srid gsum rab 'byams zhing rnams la// gaṅgā'i klung chen mchod yon brdal// dad pas rgyal la 'bul lags na// rang byung lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā// srid gsum= dag byed khrus chab zhabs bsil 'thor// dad pas= rang byung= sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pā d+yaṃ/ srid gsum= pad+ma ku muta dga' tshal rgyas// dad pas= rang byung= puṣ+pe= srid gsum= ha ri tsan+da yal 'dab bskyod// dad pas= rang byung= dhū pe= srid gsum= sur+ya tsan+d+ra'i snang gsal 'bar// dad pas= rang byung= ā lo ke= srid gsum= rmad byung sman spos byugs pa bzang// dad pas= rang byung = gan+dhe= srid gsum= yid 'phrog ro ldan zhal zas bshams// dad pas= rang byung = nai wi d+ya= srid gsum= sna tshogs grag stong sgra dbyangs ldir// dad pas rgyal la 'bul lags na// rang byung lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas 'dod yon mchod pa ni/ rdo rje'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /bde stong lha mos gar bsgyur zhing*// 'dzin med ngang du 'bul lags na// mnyam nyid dbyings su bzhes su gsol// badz+ra rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she ma hā su kha pū dza ho/ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ mchog chen bhan+dha mtshan dang ldan// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rba rlabs 'phyo// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// sarba pañtsa a mri ta la khā hi// lcang lor bcas pa'i ka pā lar// rgyu drug snying rjes bsgral ba yi// rak+ta'i rgyun gyi zegs ma 'thor// byams pa'i tshul gyis dgyes par rol// ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/

rin chen pad snod yangs pa'i nang*// bcud ldan 'dod yon ba ling ta// ri ltar brjid che mtsho ltar bskyil// kun kyang klong yangs chen por bzhes// ma hā ba ling ta la khā hi/ dngos kun rang sems snang ba'i rtsal// ka dag ye nas rdzogs pa che// gsal stong lhun grub 'dus ma byas// don dam brjod med ngang du mchod// badz+ra dzñān dharma dhā tu pū dza ho/ de nas lha tshogs ma lus pa thams cad o rgyan rin po che dang dbyer med ngang du bstod pa bya ba ni/ oṃ/ chos sku'i zhing khams kun tu khyab// āḥ longs sku 'gags med sprin tshogs gtibs// hūm̐/ sprul bsgyur chu zla'i rol pa can// sku gsum pad+ma 'byung la bstod// rang byung mtsho dbus ge sar las// bde stong brdzus 'khrungs rgyal ba'i sras// gsang sngags ston pa rdo rje 'chang*// bla med bla mar phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde bar gshegs// kun gyi spyi mes dkyil 'khor gtso// snang srid zil gnon thod phreng rtsal// che mchog dpal chen phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod bya bstod byed blo las 'das// rjod byed smra bsam yul dang bral// chos rnams ye nas rig pa'i rtsal// kun bzang klong yangs chen por bstod// ces bstod nas/ kyai/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /mi mngon dbyings nas rjes dgongs la// bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ gdod nas bag chags sgrib pa yis// gsang sngags byang sems so thar gyi// dam tshig bslab sdom nyes ltung sogs// mi shes mun pa'i dbang gyur rnams// gnong 'gyod drag pos bzod par bzhes// mi sgrib nyi ma 'bum brdal pa'i// dag tshangs dbugs dbyung bstsal du gsol// oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥ sa ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dzñā na satwa hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ bdag mdun thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba ru// hrīḥdamar mtha' skor sngags kyi phreng ba gsal// 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs// rang lus snang stong bde gsal mi rtog ngang*// mchog gsum rtsa gsum ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs// rdul snyed grangs 'das bdag rgyud byin rlob gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/

ci nus dang*/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// de nas spro na tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros 'dod yon la// thim pas kun rtog bag chags sbyangs// oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūm̐ mthing 'phros// thabs shes tshogs rdzas longs spyod kyi// snang srid mtha' bral zhing rnams bkang*// zag med ye shes bcud mchog ldan// mchod 'os skyabs gnas rgya mtsho rnams// rang bzhin gnas nas sku bskyod 'tshal// mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od zhing nas// gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// rig 'dzin grub thob bye ba 'bum// yi dam zhi khro dpa' bo dang*// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro grangs las 'das// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral dang*// dka' srung dam can dregs byed rnams// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// thugs rje'i thugs dam bskang ba dang*// rnal 'byor byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir// mkha' dbyings gang bar gshegs su gsol// phyi snod nang bcud ma lus pa// dag pa lha yi ngo bor bsgyur// gzhal yas tshogs khang nyams re dga'// rmad byung tshogs gtor dwangs re spro// skyabs gnas dkon mchog byin re che// sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dam re gtsang*// 'dir gshegs zag med ting 'dzin gyi// mchod pa chen po bzhes su gsol// dug lnga'i dbang gyur bzod par dgongs// nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i dngos snang las// 'khrul 'byams rnam rtog dgra dpung 'di// ye shes lnga yi ngang nyid du// dgyes pa chen pos da rol cig /gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ de nas bskang ba bya ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings rnam dag rang bzhin zhing khams nas// kun bzang rdor 'chang pad 'byung thugs dam bskang*// 'og min gnas dang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus thugs dam=

skye med spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi= mkha' spyod dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor nas// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs= rtsa rlung snang stong bde chen gzhal yas nas// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i= dpal ri pad+ma 'od phung 'khyil ba nas// o rgyan rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i= gang 'dul sprul sku'i gar rtsed gnas mchog nas// gter chen gter phran mnga' bdag= dag snang phyogs med snying rje'i 'od klong nas// dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma'i= 'og min dur khrod rol pa chen po nas// ye shes mgon po yongs kyi= rtsub 'gyur rab 'jigs me ri 'bar ba nas// las dang 'jig rten mgon po'i= mi bzad rlung nag dgu klong 'khyil ba nas// dpal ldan ma mo yongs kyi= drag rtsal bskal me 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas// bka' srung bstan srung rgya mtsho'i= mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor los sgyur// nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi= gnas dang zab chos bka' yi bya ra ba// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpung thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang phyir rmad byung mchod pa'i rdzas// rtsa brgyad bdud rtsi ma hā rak+ta dang*// dam rdzas stobs ldan ma hā ba ling ta// zag med bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo ldan// mchod 'os thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig /bskang med chos dbyings chen po'i ngang du bskang*// snang stong bde ba chen po'i ngang du bskang*// gzung 'dzin dngos med stong nyid chen po bskang*// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ kyai/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas// las ngan sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams// kun bzang yangs pa'i klong du bstim// dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su dag /a a a/ zhes phul lo// de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol pa ni/ ho/ dug lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin// dngos grub rdzas mchog tshogs la longs spyod mdzod// lan du/ e ma gdod nas blo 'das zag pa med// mtshan bral de bzhin nyid dbyings klong du rol// a la la hoḥ

de nas phud lhag rnams bdud rtsis bsangs la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi// bka' nyan bran g.yog pho nya'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro ging dang laṅka bcas// dbang phyug ma mo nyi shu brgyad// phra man shugs 'gro gtor len gyi// phud lhag bshal chu dbang ba rnams// dam tshig chen pos dgyes par rol// bstan srung bsgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// uts+tshi ṭa bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes phyi rol du dor/ bka' yi tha tshig bsgrag pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐/ sngon dus bskal pa dang po la// chos dbyings rol pa'i pho brang du// dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka'i// rdo rje'i bka' bsgos dbang yang bskur// de 'og rgya bod gnas rnams su// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// dregs can ma lus dbang sdud nas// phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam// de 'og rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus// rig 'dzin grub pa mchog rnams kyi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// bka' dang tha tshig ma g.yel cig /da lta bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// dkyil 'khor gnyen po zhal phyes nas// dam tshig can rnams mchod bskul na// sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// skal ldan bsrung zhing skyob pa dang*// bstan dang bstan 'dzin bar chad sol// gnad nas bskul lo phrin las mdzod//

ces phul nas/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bh+yo/ bdag nyid chen po pad 'byung gi /phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas pa'i// 'dzam gling skyong ba'i brtan ma rnams// 'dir gshegs gtor ma bshal chu bzhes// sngon tshe khas blangs mna' bor bzhin// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// pad+ma'i lung zin mchog rnams dang*// nges don gsang sngags ring lugs skyong*// rnal 'byor bar chad rkyen ngan zlog /nad yams dal kha dgra la sgyur// dug mtshon byad kha phur kha yi// rbod gtong rang gshed rang la zlog /bcol ba'i phrin las dus la babs// ma g.yel ma 'da' sa ma ya/ ma ma hring hring ba ling ta khā hi/ zhes phul nas gtor snod sbub la/ dgra bgegs sha trūṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ dpal mgon dam pa rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog /dpal ldan mtshor 'khrungs bla ma'i lha tshogs la// dpal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// dpal kun rab rgyas 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wī d+ya/ shab+da/ ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba ling ta sarba pū dza khā hi/ hrīḥ skye 'chi spangs pa'i snang stong bde ba che// 'dus ma byas pa rang gsal lhun gyis grub// 'od gsal ye shes rtsal rdzogs ye sangs rgyas// kun khyab gdod ma'i mgon por phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas bzod gsol ni/ lta sgom spyod pa bag nyal gyis// gos par gyur pa'i las bsags pa// thar pa'i sgrib tshogs ma lus bshags// tshangs par byang zhing dag par gsol// de nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i dngos grub blang ba ni/ mdun bskyed rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ hrīḥ gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye// byin rlabs 'od zer lnga ldan gyi// snang ba sprin ltar thibs se thib// dngos grub me tog char gyi rgyun// bar mtshams med par spungs se spung*// khyad par gu ru'i gnas gsum nas// 'bru gsum 'phros nas rang la thim// lus ngag yid gsum byin rlobs la// dbang bzhi bskur zhing rgyud bzhi smin// sku bzhi mngon gyur dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhe wā ḍā ki ni kā ya a bhi ṣi ñtsa oṃ/

wak+kā abhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ sarba abhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ mos gus dag snang gi 'dun pa dang bcas te dbang bzhi thob par bsgom mo// de nas bsngo ba ni/ na mo/ dus gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin mchod bzlas bskul// zag bcas zag med dge ba rnams// chos dbyings byang chub chen por bsngo// mdun bskyed ye shes rten yod na/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa bstim/ med na/ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs gsol bya/ rang nyid bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor ba// mtha' nas dbus yal hrīḥl thim// thig le nā da mi dmigs pa// dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal ngang*// ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// de nas shis pa'i me tog 'thor ba ni/ bkra shis gang zhig lha lam klong yangs su// gu ru pad+ma nyin byed 'bum 'od brdal// deng 'dir rab dkar me tog chos spyod bcu'i// sgrub pa mthar phyin srid zhi bde legs shog /bkra shis rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje can// chu shel byams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bsil rgyun 'bebs// deng 'dir nyon mongs mun pa pha mthar gzhil// yang dag don gsal bde legs kun 'byung shog /bkra shis yi dam dpa' bo ḍā ki ma// chos skyong nor lha skar tshogs 'bum bkra zhing*// deng 'dir phyi nang snod bcud dpal phun tshogs// rab brtan lhun gyis grub pa'i shis pa rtsol// bkra shis skal ldan rgya mtsho mtha' klas dbus// nor bu yid bzhin dbang rgyal sangs rgyas bstan// de 'dzin gdengs can bdag po ma lus rnams// g.yo med nyin mtshan bkra shis 'byung gyur cig /dge tshogs ri dbang lhun po'i dpangs ltar mtho// legs byas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'di phul mthus// 'og min mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od zhing du// rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid dang dbyer med shog /maṅga lam swa sti dza ya su dza ya/ ces brjod par bya'o// de ltar gu ru pad+ma bsgrub pa'i mchod phreng 'di nyid kyang bslab gsum mngon mtho dad nor gyis phyug pa/

dge slong karma legs sbyin nas/ ston pa'i gser sku 'phags yul gyi bzo khyad can dang*/ nyes sras rgya nag gi ri mo'i 'du byed can bzang gos kyi gong gsham ldan pa/ chu dar dri med bcas dngos 'byor maṇ+ḍal rten 'brel dge mtshan dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa o rgyan chen pos byin gyis brlabs par mos pa pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dpal spungs yang dben du rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la spel ba 'gro rnams kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi go 'phang mngon du thob par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/ sid+dhi bha wan+tu/ dge'o/// / ༈ chos rnams dmigs med stong pa chen po'i ngang*// stong pa'i ngang las mdun mkhar seng ge'i khrir// dar dang rin po ches brgyan de steng du// rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang*// thod pa tshe bum gru mor kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /sku la phod ka chos gos zab ber gsol// zhabs gnyis rdor skyil dbu la pad zhwa dang*// snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bus brgyan// 'ja' 'od klong du gsal 'tsher 'od 'bar bskyed// gzhan yang bla ma yi dam ḍā ki dang*// ye shes chos skyong la sogs sprin ltar 'khrigs// skyabs gnas mchog gsum rtsa gsum ngo bo nyid// kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la// phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas shing*/ skyabs yul 'od zhu rang gi spyi bor thim// dbang bzhi mchog thob sgrib bzhi rnam par dag /sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ldan zhing*// 'das dang ma 'ongs rtog pa'i rjes mi 'brang*// da lta'i shes pa gang shar bzo med ngang*// gsal stong 'dzin med ma bcos lhug bar bzhag / bsngo smon bya'o// de ltar dad stobs 'byor pa mngon mtho hor karma mgon po'i bzhed ltar spel/// /

༈ na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa spro na/ oṃ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs la/ rang lus 'dzin med spyi bor pad+ma dang*// nyi zla'i steng du o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// mtshan dpe'i cha rdzogs gzi byin lham me ba// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sprin ltar gtibs// dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs bcas gsal// rang snang rtsal las phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// phyogs bcu dus gsum bder gshegs ma lus pa'i// spyi gzugs rigs 'dus khyab bdag he ru ka/ bdag sogs snyigs 'gro'i sems can brtser dgongs la// thugs rjes rgyud brlan smin cing grol nas su// sgrub pa mthar phyin phyi nang bar chad zhi// lhan skyes ye shes sgrib bral rtogs byin rlobs// ces gsol ba btab nas/ badz+ra gu ru ci nus bgrang la mthar byin rlabs dbang bzhi zhu ba ni/ gu ru'i gsang gsum ye shes rdo rje bzhi'i// ngo bo 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros// bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// sgrib bzhi dag cing lam bzhi 'byong ba dang*// sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la yongs smin nas// bla ma 'od zhu dbyer med ma bcos ngang*// ka nas dag pa rang bzhin gnyug ma'i gnas// kun bzang bde ba chen po'i klong du bzhag / ci gnas su ngo bo bskyangs la mthar/ dge des mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// bla med thar pa'i grong du 'jug nas su// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon gyur pa'i// rang byung pad+ma'i go 'phang mchog thob shog / ces pa'ang si tu pas rje dbon gang de'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ swasti/ 'dir gu ru rin po che'i rnal 'byor sgom rim dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod skong bshags kyi rim pa khyer bder spro na/ rten dang gtor ma mchod rdzas rnams gang 'byor dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs bshams la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni/

na mo/ skyabs yul dam pa rtsa ba gsum gyi lhar// bdag sogs sems can rtag par skyabs mchi zhing*// 'gro rnams srid pa'i gzeb las nges sgrol phyir// yang dag byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas bskyed rim ni/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags kyis sbya ’ ngas la/ snang srid gnyis bsdus chos rnams stong nyid gyur// de yi ngang las mdun mkhar 'ja' 'od klong*// pad+ma dkar po 'dab stong ge sar rgyas// de dbus nyi zlar hrīḥyig 'od 'phros pas// don gnyis byas te yongs gyur o rgyan rje// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar// zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dpal ldan// pad zhwa phod ka chos gos rnam gsum dang*// za 'og ber chen bklubs gsol phyag gnyis kyis// rdo rje thod chang tshe yi bum bzang 'dzin// kha ṭ+wāṃ dkur brten 'gyings bag tshul zhabs gnyis// rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis lhun chags bzhugs// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams 'khor los sgyur// gang skur gdod nas zhing gi yon tan rdzogs// gnam sa bla 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad par// byin rlabs rtsa ba rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// dgu ldan brgyud pa'i grub thob rig pa 'dzin// dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam zhi dang khro// phrin las rtsa ba bka' sdod chos srung rnams// bkra gsal lam mer mngon sum snang bar gyur// gtso 'khor kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan// khyad par thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i// bde chen pad+ma 'od phung 'khyil ba nas// ye shes gtso 'khor sprul dang yang sprul rnams// nyi dang 'od zer ji bzhin mdun bskyed kyi// dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas la thim gnyis med gyur// rol mo dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/

na mo/ chos dbyings kun khyab 'gags med rang rtsal las// ye nas grub pa sku gsum dbyer med klong*// don dam sems kyi rdo rje gnyug ma'i gshis// mngon du rtogs pa de bzhin nyid phyag 'tshal// de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyi dang nang mchod gsang ba de kho na'i// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa las// mkha' dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'i mchod sprin tshogs// 'bul bzhes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bar dang*/ ma hā pañtsa/ rak+ta/ ba liṃ ta/ gu h+ya sarba pū dza hoḥ de nas dzab bzlas dmigs pa/ mdun bskyed thugs kar pad steng rdo rje'i lter// zla dkyil hrīḥyig mtha' mar sngags phreng bskor// de las 'od 'phros 'phags mchod sems can gyi// sgrib sbyang snod bcud dag pa gsum ldan gyur// badz+ra gu ru ci nus bzla zhing*/ thod phreng rtsal yang bzla'o// de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa bsangs sbyangs pa ni/ hrīḥ stong gsal 'dzin bral de bzhin nyid// bde chen bde ba'i longs spyod rdzas// skye 'gag gnyis med snang cha las// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros bsreg gtor sbyang*// hrīḥ sku gsum ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐// 'od zhu zag med bdud rtsi mchog /ra sa ya na'i mchod pa che// 'dod yon ye shes lnga dang ldan// thabs shes zung 'jug tshogs 'khor lo// mchod yul dgyes pa skyed byed gyur// tshogs la spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas// mtsho skyes rang byung rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor du grub pa'i rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum// 'dir gshegs ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa bzhes// gsang ba'i dgyes sde ye shes ḍā ki'i gtso// man+da ra ba yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang*// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// ma mgon lcam dral dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang*// skyes bu rdor legs bka' srung chos skyong ba// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor bcas rnams/

gnas 'dir sku bskyod tshogs gtor 'bul gyi bzhes// o shrī mān gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ pañtsa a mri ta la khā hi// de nas tshogs phud phul la/ bar pa dang*/ tha ma rnams kyang rim par spros shing 'bul/ skong bshags ni/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin rnam dag skye med dag pa'i klong*// lhun grub snang ba'i rol pa he ru ka'i// gnas yul dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir// tshogs rje tshogs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bka' gter brgyud pa'i skyes mchog bla rabs phreng*// grub ba'i sar gnas rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga// theg pa rim dgur 'dus pa'i zhi dang khro// rmad byung dam tshig rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// rdo rje ber can rang byung srid pa'i rgyal// kun dga' gzhon nu badz+ra sā dhu sogs// mthu stobs rtsal ldan dam can srung ma rnams// gtor tshogs brten pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// hoḥ gdod nas dri bral dus gsum kun mkhyen zhing*// chos kyi dbyings nyid spros mtshan las 'das kyang*// bdag sogs nyon mongs ma rig 'khrul dbang gis// nongs par gyur rnams bzod bzhes tshangs par stsol// bskang dang bshags bya rang bzhin dmigs med ngang*// don dam spros bral chos nyid klong du bskang*// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ kun rtog dug lngas bslad pa'i ngar 'dzin 'phrul// bar chad bdud bzhi log 'dren dgra bgegs rnams// stong nyid snying rje'i mtshon gyis bsgral byas te// phung khams skye mched chos dbyings ngang du rol// ces phul lo// de nas tshogs kyi dngos grub la spyod cing*/ lhag gtor ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gnyen po'i mu ran skyong ba yi// bstan srung mkha' 'gro tshogs kyis lhag rol rnams// gtor mar bzhes la rnal 'byor srung zhing skyob// phrin las thogs med 'grub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod// u3lt;?>ི ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi/

zhes phul/ bka'i chad tho dang brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon 'das bar dang tha ma'i dus tshigs la// che mchog drag pos bka' bsgos tha tshig can// ye shes las dang 'jig rten dregs byed rnams// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// bod skyong ma yams brtan ma bcu gnyis kyang*// sngon tshe zhal bzhes rjes dgongs gtor ma dang*// bshal chu bzhes la rkyen ngan bar chad zlog / ces phul/ de nas rjes rim byin rlabs bsdu pa ni/ hrīḥ gtso mchog rdo rje 'dzin rgyal dgongs su gsol// bdag rgyud byin rlobs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// gsol btab mod la 'khor rnams bla mar thim// sku las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros// rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// rgyud bzhi smin cing sku bzhi mngon du gyur// slar yang dgyes pa dang bcas 'od zhu nas// dbyer med ngang du ma bcos lhug par bzhag /

gnas lugs kyi ngo bo bskyangs la/ mthar bsngo smon ni/ dge des rgyu drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// rnam grol byang chub lam bzang thob phyir bsngo// bkra shis mchog thun dngos grub yongs 'du'i ljon// 'bad med bsam don 'bras smin bde legs shog / ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos rje'i dbon mo chos mdzad ma karma dharma tā res bskul ngor bkod pa dge'o// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ chos kun gdod nas skye 'gag gnas bral ngang*// rang nyid lhar gsal spyi gtsug pad+ma dkar// ge sar rab rgyas 'dab stong ldan pa'i steng*// nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bkra gsal 'od 'tsher dbus// hrīḥdamar 'phro 'dus rgyal kun 'dus pa'i mgon// sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar dmar mdangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje thod bum bsnams// kha ṭ+waṃ dkur brten za 'og phod ka dang*// chos gos rnam gsum pad zhwa sgro dar mdzes// rin chen rgyan spras zhabs gnyis rdor skyil bzhugs// ye shes lnga ldan thig le thig phran dbus// snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon ltar// gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan// de las 'od 'phros pad+ma 'od zhing nas// bsgom pa dang 'dra'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gcig 'dres gyur// sprul pa'i lha mos phyi nang gsang ba dang*// yang gsang de kho na yi mchod pas mchod// nyams gyur nyes bshags dam bskang dngos grub stsol// thugs kar zla steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i// lte bar hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyud sde rab 'byams dang*// ye shes chos skyong rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i tshogs// kun gyi thugs rje 'od zer lnga ldan tshul// bsdus nas sngags kyi 'khor lo la thim gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla/ slar yang lha sku stong gsal de yi ngang*// o rgyan chen po'i gsang gsum ye shes kyi// rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo 'bru gsum las// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing 'phros 'od du zhu// sgo gsum la thim dug gsum rnam rtog zhi// sku gsum mngon gyur rang rig ye shes che'i// rgyas gdab dus gsum spros pa'i chos thams cad// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin sems ngo bo// gang shar ma bcos so ma'i gnas lugs skyong*//

ci gnas su nyams len ngo bo bskyang*/ dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags yod kun// 'gro rnams 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// thugs rjes yang dag lam 'god smin grol gyis// lta ba 'khrul med nyid du rtogs pa dang*// mthar thug bla med go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// ces pa'ang dge slong rtogs ldan rab 'byor nas bskul bzhin spel/ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od// snang bas deng 'dir bkra shis pa'i// bde legs dpal dang 'byor ba yis// kun nas kun tu dge gyur cig / ces pa'ang si tu pa pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge// / ༈ dam ldan rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la don gyi byin rlabs bka' bsgo ni/ sngon tshe rdo rje phag mos gu ru rin po che'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gsol 'debs tshig bdun mar grags pa der 'brel gter gzhung rdo rje'i gsung gsang bla na med pa'i byin 'bebs ting 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur ba bcas shin tu 'thus khyab che bas thugs rje mchog tu gyur cing*/ gzhan dang phal mo cher nyer 'tshe las srung phyir bka' bsgo'i rim pa spro na/ na mo/ che ba'i che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dus gsum khro rgyal stobs 'dus he ru ka'i// bden pa'i byin rlabs mthu yis bsrung bya la// gnyis 'dzin snang ba'i log 'dren gdon bgegs rnams// dam tshig gnyen las ma 'da' phyir dengs shig /de bas rdo rje'i char gyis brlag ta re// sum+bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad yungs kar brab la/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ spro na gsang gsum gyi rten spyi bor bzhag pa bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag pad+ma 'byung*// thugs rje'i mthu stobs skal ldan rgyud smin nas// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med par// rgyas gdab mi 'gyur gzhom zhig bral ba'i ngang*// gdod nas rtag pa dam pa'i go 'phang che// chos dbyings skye med klong du sa ma dhi/

cung zad mnyam par bzhag /mthar/ dzñā na badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gis slar yang bsrung ba'i go bgo zhing brtan par byas so// zhes pa'ang rgyal dbang rin po che'i bka' stsal ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos phul ba maṅga lam/// /
